name: Cocoa
read: Cocoa Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 5046, 93 days to expiry 2027-02-12): at-the-money implied vol 42.4%, +0.8 pts vs 2026-11-05. 20-day realized vol 37.9%, so options trade at a premium of 4.5 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +8.0 (calls over puts). Over the last 6 sessions (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-11) call open interest rose 6,245 and puts rose 4,277; put/call OI 0.44 → 0.45, front futures 5556 → 5046. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,346 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 37.6% → 40.1%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 6000 calls (5,726 lots) and 4500 puts (3,286). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 6000 calls +2,070; May 27 5500 calls +1,850. Biggest cut: Dec 26 5000 calls -1,196.
